editorial_policy: Publish only current, verifiable agricultural news from official or authoritative sources. Store the original source URL and verification date. Do not copy full articles.

articles.title: At AGROW dialogue, minister calls for national digital farmers register
articles.summary: At the National Strategic Dialogue on AGROW's digital agriculture architecture on 29 September 2026, Nigeria's agriculture minister called for a national digital farmers register to reduce duplicate records and better target support. The ministry says the work will build on existing farmer databases and links with the national identity system.
articles.source: Federal Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security (FMAFS), Nigeria

fr.title: Lors du dialogue AGROW, le ministre appelle à un registre national des agriculteurs
fr.summary: Lors du dialogue stratégique national sur l’architecture agricole numérique d’AGROW, le 29 septembre 2026, le ministre nigérian de l’Agriculture a appelé à créer un registre national des agriculteurs afin de réduire les doublons et de mieux cibler les aides. Le ministère indique que ce travail s’appuiera sur les bases de données existantes et les liens avec le système national d’identité.

ar.title: في حوار أغرو، الوزير يدعو إلى سجل وطني للمزارعين
ar.summary: خلال الحوار الاستراتيجي الوطني حول البنية الرقمية للزراعة ضمن برنامج أغرو في 29 سبتمبر 2026، دعا وزير الزراعة النيجيري إلى إنشاء سجل وطني للمزارعين للحد من تكرار السجلات وتحسين توجيه الدعم. وتقول الوزارة إن العمل سيستند إلى قواعد بيانات المزارعين الحالية والروابط مع نظام الهوية الوطني.

pt.title: No diálogo AGROW, ministro defende um registo nacional de agricultores
pt.summary: Durante o Diálogo Estratégico Nacional sobre a arquitetura agrícola digital do AGROW, em 29 de setembro de 2026, o ministro da Agricultura da Nigéria defendeu um registo nacional de agricultores para reduzir duplicações e direcionar melhor o apoio. O ministério afirma que o trabalho aproveitará bases de dados de agricultores existentes e ligações ao sistema nacional de identidade.

sw.title: Katika mazungumzo ya AGROW, waziri ataka sajili ya kitaifa ya wakulima
sw.summary: Katika Mazungumzo ya Kitaifa ya Kimkakati kuhusu usanifu wa kilimo cha kidijitali wa AGROW tarehe 29 Septemba 2026, waziri wa kilimo wa Nigeria alitaka kuanzishwa kwa sajili ya kitaifa ya wakulima ili kupunguza rekodi zinazojirudia na kuelekeza msaada vizuri zaidi. Wizara inasema kazi hiyo itatumia hifadhidata zilizopo za wakulima na miunganisho na mfumo wa kitaifa wa utambulisho.

articles.title: IFAD joins Nigeria AgriConnect to accelerate agricultural transformation
articles.summary: IFAD joined Nigeria, the World Bank and partners around a national framework focused on farmer organizations, market links, finance, digital solutions and private-sector participation.

articles.title: FAO GIEWS updates Nigeria agricultural and food-security outlook
articles.summary: The latest country brief reports uncertain 2026 cereal production prospects, elevated food inflation and severe food-security pressures in Borno State, while noting localized production impacts from dry spells in several southern and central states.

articles.title: World Bank approves $500 million Nigeria AGROW project
articles.summary: The new project targets smallholder productivity, stronger agricultural value chains and jobs, with a results-based matching-grant facility for eligible agribusinesses and priority value chains including rice, maize, cassava and soybeans.

articles.title: AfDB approves $200 million to boost Nigeria agricultural production
articles.summary: The financing supports agricultural inputs, priority crop value chains, extension, digital and climate-smart agriculture and agricultural data management under the second phase of NAGS-AP.

articles.title: Country joins 2026 FAO Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum for agrifood investment
articles.summary: Nigeria is among 20 African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment plans at the FAO 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome from 13–16 October 2026.

articles.title: FAO Hand-in-Hand Nigeria 2026 — agrifood investment portfolio
articles.summary: FAO's 2026 Nigeria investment profile identifies a USD 3.2 billion total investment portfolio, including fisheries and aquaculture and beef-feedlot opportunities, with financial, beneficiary and sustainability indicators.

articles.title: TAAT III continues scaling climate-resilient agricultural technologies across Africa
articles.summary: The AfDB-backed TAAT programme, implemented with IITA, is supporting the scale-up of proven agricultural technologies, seed systems and climate-resilient production solutions.

articles.title: IITA strengthens digital breeding capacity across Nigeria and Africa
articles.summary: IITA's 2026 pilot is strengthening digital breeding data management and analytics for researchers and national breeding systems in Nigeria, Ghana, Uganda and Tanzania.

articles.title: IFAD’s AgTech and FinTech evidence grant call closed on 13 May 2026
articles.summary: IFAD’s call sought an implementing partner to generate evidence on AgTech and FinTech services for rural smallholders. The official call page lists a submission deadline of 13 May 2026, which has passed. This was an institutional grant opportunity, not a direct grant application for individual Nigerian farmers.

fr.title: L’appel à subventions d’IFAD sur les preuves AgTech et FinTech a pris fin le 13 mai 2026
fr.summary: L’appel d’IFAD visait à sélectionner un partenaire chargé de produire des données sur les services AgTech et FinTech destinés aux petits producteurs ruraux. La page officielle indique une date limite de dépôt au 13 mai 2026, désormais dépassée. Il s’agissait d’une subvention institutionnelle, et non d’une aide directe destinée aux agriculteurs nigérians.

ar.title: انتهى في 13 مايو 2026 طلب عروض إيفاد بشأن الأدلة على حلول التكنولوجيا الزراعية والمالية
ar.summary: استهدف طلب عروض إيفاد اختيار شريك لتنفيذ أعمال لإنتاج أدلة حول خدمات التكنولوجيا الزراعية والمالية لصغار المنتجين في المناطق الريفية. وتحدد الصفحة الرسمية 13 مايو 2026 موعداً نهائياً لتقديم الطلبات، وقد انقضى. كانت هذه فرصة منحة لمؤسسة، وليست منحة مباشرة للمزارعين الأفراد في نيجيريا.

pt.title: O concurso do FIDA para evidências de soluções AgTech e FinTech encerrou em 13 de maio de 2026
pt.summary: O concurso do FIDA procurava selecionar um parceiro para produzir evidências sobre serviços AgTech e FinTech destinados a pequenos produtores rurais. A página oficial indica o prazo de 13 de maio de 2026, já ultrapassado. Tratava-se de uma oportunidade de subvenção institucional, não de uma candidatura direta para agricultores nigerianos.

sw.title: Wito wa IFAD wa ushahidi kuhusu suluhisho za AgTech na FinTech ulifungwa tarehe 13 Mei 2026
sw.summary: Wito wa IFAD ulilenga kuchagua mshirika wa kutengeneza ushahidi kuhusu huduma za AgTech na FinTech kwa wakulima wadogo wa vijijini. Ukurasa rasmi unaonyesha tarehe ya mwisho ya maombi kuwa 13 Mei 2026, ambayo imepita. Hii ilikuwa fursa ya ruzuku kwa taasisi, si ruzuku ya moja kwa moja kwa wakulima binafsi wa Nigeria.

articles.title: AfDB approves US$200 million to boost Nigeria agricultural production
articles.summary: The African Development Bank approved US$200 million for NAGS-AP Phase II, targeting agricultural productivity, priority value chains, extension, digital and climate-smart farming, and agricultural data.

articles.title: AfDB awards US$16.61 million TAAT-III grant to IITA
articles.summary: AfDB and IITA launched TAAT-III to scale climate-resilient agricultural technologies, strengthen seed systems and expand partnerships across Africa.

articles.title: World Bank approves US$500 million Nigeria AGROW agricultural value-chain project
articles.summary: The World Bank approved a six-year AGROW project to raise smallholder productivity, strengthen rice, maize, cassava and soybean value chains, expand agribusiness matching grants, improve seed and fertilizer systems, and build a national digital farm and farmer registry.

articles.title: Nigeria reaffirms national cooperative identity reform to improve agricultural finance
articles.summary: Nigeria’s Federal Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security says implementation of the National Cooperative Identity Reform has begun under the Renewed Hope Cooperative Reform and Revamp Programme. The digital register and verifiable cooperative IDs are intended to improve data quality, accountability and access to finance and services for cooperatives, including farmer groups. The announcement describes a reform rollout, not an open grant application.
articles.source: Federal Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security (FMAFS), Nigeria

fr.title: Le Nigeria réaffirme la réforme de l’identité des coopératives pour améliorer le financement agricole
fr.summary: Le ministère fédéral nigérian de l’Agriculture et de la Sécurité alimentaire indique que la mise en œuvre de la réforme nationale de l’identité des coopératives a commencé dans le cadre du programme Renewed Hope Cooperative Reform and Revamp. Le registre numérique et les identifiants vérifiables visent à améliorer la qualité des données, la responsabilité et l’accès des coopératives, y compris les groupes d’agriculteurs, au financement et aux services. Il s’agit du déploiement d’une réforme, et non d’un appel ouvert à candidatures pour une subvention.

ar.title: نيجيريا تؤكد مجدداً إصلاح الهوية الوطنية للتعاونيات لتحسين التمويل الزراعي
ar.summary: تقول وزارة الزراعة والأمن الغذائي الاتحادية في نيجيريا إن تنفيذ إصلاح الهوية الوطنية للتعاونيات قد بدأ ضمن برنامج إصلاح وتجديد التعاونيات «الأمل المتجدد». ويهدف السجل الرقمي ومعرّفات التعاونيات القابلة للتحقق إلى تحسين جودة البيانات والمساءلة وإتاحة التمويل والخدمات للتعاونيات، بما فيها مجموعات المزارعين. ويصف الإعلان بدء تنفيذ إصلاح، وليس دعوة مفتوحة للتقدم بطلب منحة.

pt.title: Nigéria reafirma reforma da identidade das cooperativas para melhorar o financiamento agrícola
pt.summary: O Ministério Federal da Agricultura e Segurança Alimentar da Nigéria informa que começou a implementação da reforma nacional da identidade das cooperativas, no âmbito do programa Renewed Hope Cooperative Reform and Revamp. O registo digital e os identificadores verificáveis destinam-se a melhorar a qualidade dos dados, a responsabilização e o acesso ao financiamento e a serviços para cooperativas, incluindo grupos de agricultores. O anúncio descreve a implementação de uma reforma, não uma candidatura aberta a subsídios.

sw.title: Nigeria yathibitisha mageuzi ya utambulisho wa vyama vya ushirika ili kuboresha ufadhili wa kilimo
sw.summary: Wizara ya Kilimo na Usalama wa Chakula ya Shirikisho la Nigeria inasema utekelezaji wa mageuzi ya kitaifa ya utambulisho wa vyama vya ushirika umeanza chini ya mpango wa Renewed Hope Cooperative Reform and Revamp. Sajili ya kidijitali na vitambulisho vya ushirika vinavyoweza kuthibitishwa vinakusudiwa kuboresha ubora wa data, uwajibikaji na upatikanaji wa fedha na huduma kwa vyama vya ushirika, ikiwemo vikundi vya wakulima. Tangazo hili linaeleza utekelezaji wa mageuzi, si mwaliko wa wazi wa kutuma maombi ya ruzuku.

articles.title: IFAD partners with Ghana and World Bank through AgriConnect Compact
articles.summary: The Ghana AgriConnect Compact brings together government, IFAD, the World Bank and partners to accelerate agri-food transformation and inclusive economic growth.

articles.title: Ghana launches National Horticultural Seed Roadmap
articles.summary: Ghana’s Ministry of Food and Agriculture launched a roadmap to strengthen the horticultural seed sector over the next three to five years. It focuses on increasing the availability and use of quality seeds and seedlings for crops including tomatoes, onions, peppers and indigenous vegetables. Implementation details and financing arrangements are still to be developed.

fr.title: Le Ghana lance une feuille de route nationale pour les semences horticoles
fr.summary: Le ministère ghanéen de l’Alimentation et de l’Agriculture a lancé une feuille de route visant à renforcer le secteur des semences horticoles au cours des trois à cinq prochaines années. Elle vise à accroître la disponibilité et l’utilisation de semences et de plants de qualité pour des cultures comme les tomates, les oignons, les poivrons et les légumes locaux. Les modalités de mise en œuvre et de financement restent à définir.

ar.title: غانا تطلق خارطة طريق وطنية لبذور البستنة
ar.summary: أطلقت وزارة الغذاء والزراعة في غانا خارطة طريق لتعزيز قطاع بذور البستنة خلال السنوات الثلاث إلى الخمس المقبلة. وتركز على زيادة توافر واستخدام البذور والشتلات عالية الجودة لمحاصيل تشمل الطماطم والبصل والفلفل والخضروات المحلية. ولا تزال تفاصيل التنفيذ والترتيبات التمويلية بحاجة إلى التطوير.

pt.title: Gana lança roteiro nacional para sementes hortícolas
pt.summary: O Ministério da Alimentação e Agricultura do Gana lançou um roteiro para reforçar o setor de sementes hortícolas nos próximos três a cinco anos. O plano pretende aumentar a disponibilidade e a utilização de sementes e mudas de qualidade para culturas como tomate, cebola, pimento e hortícolas locais. Os detalhes de implementação e financiamento ainda serão desenvolvidos.

sw.title: Ghana yazindua ramani ya kitaifa ya mbegu za mazao ya bustani
sw.summary: Wizara ya Chakula na Kilimo ya Ghana imezindua ramani ya kuimarisha sekta ya mbegu za mazao ya bustani katika miaka mitatu hadi mitano ijayo. Inalenga kuongeza upatikanaji na matumizi ya mbegu na miche bora ya nyanya, vitunguu, pilipili na mboga za asili. Maelezo ya utekelezaji na mipango ya ufadhili bado yanahitaji kuandaliwa.

articles.title: Ghana launches Tomato Self-Sufficiency Initiative to boost local production
articles.summary: Ghana’s Ministry of Food and Agriculture launched the Ghana Tomato Self-Sufficiency Initiative on 15 September 2026, targeting annual production of 400,000 tonnes. The initiative is intended to strengthen domestic production, storage, processing and market access, but the target is a stated ambition rather than a verified production result.

fr.title: Le Ghana lance une initiative d’autosuffisance en tomates pour stimuler la production locale
fr.summary: Le ministère ghanéen de l’Alimentation et de l’Agriculture a lancé l’Initiative pour l’autosuffisance en tomates le 15 septembre 2026, avec un objectif de production annuelle de 400 000 tonnes. L’initiative vise à renforcer la production nationale, le stockage, la transformation et l’accès aux marchés ; cet objectif est une ambition annoncée et non un résultat de production déjà vérifié.

ar.title: غانا تطلق مبادرة الاكتفاء الذاتي من الطماطم لتعزيز الإنتاج المحلي
ar.summary: أطلقت وزارة الغذاء والزراعة في غانا مبادرة الاكتفاء الذاتي من الطماطم في 15 سبتمبر 2026، مستهدفة إنتاج 400 ألف طن سنوياً. وتهدف المبادرة إلى تعزيز الإنتاج المحلي والتخزين والتصنيع والوصول إلى الأسواق، لكن هذا الهدف طموح معلن وليس نتيجة إنتاج تم التحقق منها.

pt.title: Gana lança iniciativa de autossuficiência em tomate para impulsionar a produção local
pt.summary: O Ministério da Alimentação e Agricultura do Gana lançou a Iniciativa de Autossuficiência em Tomate em 15 de setembro de 2026, com a meta de produzir 400 mil toneladas por ano. A iniciativa pretende reforçar a produção nacional, o armazenamento, o processamento e o acesso ao mercado; a meta é uma ambição anunciada, não um resultado de produção já verificado.

sw.title: Ghana yazindua mpango wa kujitosheleza kwa nyanya ili kuongeza uzalishaji wa ndani
sw.summary: Wizara ya Chakula na Kilimo ya Ghana ilizindua Mpango wa Kujitosheleza kwa Nyanya tarehe 15 Septemba 2026, ukiwa na lengo la uzalishaji wa tani 400,000 kwa mwaka. Mpango unalenga kuimarisha uzalishaji wa ndani, uhifadhi, uchakataji na upatikanaji wa masoko; lengo hilo ni azma iliyotangazwa, si matokeo ya uzalishaji yaliyothibitishwa.

articles.title: AfDB approves $18.8 million grant for Ghana rice production
articles.summary: The REWARD project will support climate-resilient rice production, quality inputs, mechanisation, irrigation, processing and market linkages in Ghana's rice value chain.

articles.title: IFAD partners with Ghana and World Bank on AgriConnect
articles.summary: IFAD reaffirmed its partnership with Ghana and the World Bank to accelerate transformation of the country's agri-food systems and inclusive economic growth.

articles.title: Ghana launches AgriConnect Compact
articles.summary: Ghana and development partners launched a national framework covering food security, jobs, investment, value addition, irrigation, seed systems, mechanisation, farmer services and agricultural finance.

articles.title: Country joins 2026 FAO Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum for agrifood investment
articles.summary: Ghana is among 20 African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment plans at the FAO 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome from 13–16 October 2026.

articles.title: FAO Hand-in-Hand Ghana 2026 — agrifood investment opportunities
articles.summary: Ghana's 2026 Hand-in-Hand investment plan highlights priority agrifood value chains including rice, maize, cocoa, oil palm and livestock-related opportunities.

articles.title: FAO Hand-in-Hand Ghana 2026 — investment portfolio and priority value chains
articles.summary: FAO's country investment profile presents a USD 1.2 billion agrifood investment opportunity, with 16% overall internal rate of return, USD 462.7 million NPV and 56,648 direct beneficiaries. Cases include cassava production, broiler processing, soybean production and processing, and rice processing.

articles.title: Ghana launches AgriConnect Compact to strengthen food security and mobilise investment
articles.summary: Ghana launched a national AgriConnect framework prioritising cocoa, oil palm, rice, maize and poultry and seeking about USD 3.5 billion for its first phase.

articles.title: World Bank Group launches soil-health agricultural-support programme across six African countries
articles.summary: Ghana, Kenya, Malawi, Senegal, Tanzania and Zambia are participating in a programme to improve fertilizer-support design, soil health, productivity and private-sector mobilisation.

articles.title: IITA strengthens digital breeding capacity across Nigeria and Africa
articles.summary: IITA's regional pilot is strengthening digital breeding data management and analytics for researchers and national breeding systems in Ghana and partner countries.

articles.title: FAO advances Seeds to Foods initiative for resilient agrifood systems
articles.summary: FAO highlighted Seeds to Foods 2026 as a platform for stronger seed systems and food-security outcomes across Africa.

articles.title: AfDB agriculture portfolio includes West Africa rice programme REWARD G2
articles.summary: The African Development Bank's current agriculture portfolio lists the multinational Regional Program for Rice Development in West Africa (REWARD G2), with Ghana participation.

articles.title: FAO highlights Seeds to Foods 2026 and African value-chain innovation
articles.summary: FAO's Seeds to Foods 2026 showcase highlights African crops, seed-to-food value chains, women, youth and opportunities to turn agricultural biodiversity into stronger food systems.

articles.title: African countries strengthen agricultural heritage systems capacity
articles.summary: FAO reported that a Johannesburg workshop brought 16 African countries together to strengthen agricultural heritage proposals, action plans, partnerships and resource mobilisation.

articles.title: AICCRA–FSRP4 expands climate-smart agriculture innovation in Ghana
articles.summary: The World Bank-backed programme will scale agricultural innovations and climate information services in Ghana, strengthening links between research institutions, farmers and food-system actors.

articles.title: IFAD and AgDevCo target early-stage agricultural enterprises in Africa
articles.summary: A US$10 million blended-finance initiative initially focuses on Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania and Uganda, supporting early-stage agricultural enterprises and smallholder-linked value chains.

articles.title: FAO opens direct beneficiary grants for nature-positive livelihoods in Western Kenya
articles.summary: FAO announced a GEF-7 FOLUR call supporting eligible Kenyan producer organizations, cooperatives and community organizations working in coffee, maize and related nature-based livelihoods in the Mt. Elgon landscape.

fr.title: La FAO ouvre des subventions directes pour des moyens de subsistance favorables à la nature dans l'ouest du Kenya
fr.summary: La FAO a annoncé un appel du GEF-7 FOLUR destiné aux organisations de producteurs, coopératives et organisations communautaires éligibles au Kenya, travaillant dans le café, le maïs et des moyens de subsistance liés à la nature dans le paysage du mont Elgon.

ar.title: الفاو تفتح منحاً مباشرة للمستفيدين من أجل سبل عيش داعمة للطبيعة في غرب كينيا
ar.summary: أعلنت الفاو دعوة من مرفق البيئة العالمية ضمن برنامج FOLUR لدعم منظمات المنتجين والتعاونيات والمنظمات المجتمعية المؤهلة في كينيا والعاملة في القهوة والذرة وسبل العيش المرتبطة بالطبيعة في منطقة جبل إلغون.

pt.title: FAO abre subvenções diretas para beneficiários de meios de subsistência favoráveis à natureza no oeste do Quénia
pt.summary: A FAO anunciou uma oportunidade GEF-7 FOLUR para apoiar organizações de produtores, cooperativas e organizações comunitárias elegíveis no Quénia que trabalham com café, milho e meios de subsistência baseados na natureza na paisagem do Monte Elgon.

sw.title: FAO yafungua ruzuku za moja kwa moja kwa walengwa wa maisha yanayolinda mazingira magharibi mwa Kenya
sw.summary: FAO imetangaza wito wa GEF-7 FOLUR unaolenga kusaidia mashirika ya wazalishaji, vyama vya ushirika na mashirika ya jamii yanayostahili nchini Kenya yanayofanya kazi na kahawa, mahindi na maisha yanayotegemea uhifadhi wa mazingira katika eneo la Mlima Elgon.

articles.title: FAO GIEWS reports major rainfall and agricultural risks in Kenya
articles.summary: The latest GIEWS brief reports exceptionally high early 2026 long-rains in key crop areas, improving some conditions while increasing risks from excessive rainfall, fertilizer constraints and later rainfall variability.

articles.title: AfDB publishes June 2026 implementation report for Kenya ENABLE Youth
articles.summary: The African Development Bank lists a June 2026 implementation progress report for its ongoing ENABLE Youth Kenya project. The programme supports youth-led agribusiness and employment; the project page provides the official project record and related implementation reports. The listing is a progress-report publication, not a new grant application.

fr.title: La BAD publie le rapport de mise en œuvre de juin 2026 du programme ENABLE Youth Kenya
fr.summary: La Banque africaine de développement répertorie un rapport d’avancement de juin 2026 pour son projet ENABLE Youth Kenya, toujours en cours. Le programme soutient l’entrepreneuriat agricole des jeunes et l’emploi ; la page du projet fournit la fiche officielle et les rapports de mise en œuvre associés. Il s’agit de la publication d’un rapport d’avancement, et non d’un nouvel appel à subventions.

ar.title: البنك الأفريقي للتنمية ينشر تقرير تنفيذ يونيو 2026 لبرنامج ENABLE Youth في كينيا
ar.summary: يسرد البنك الأفريقي للتنمية تقرير تقدم التنفيذ لشهر يونيو 2026 لمشروع ENABLE Youth Kenya المستمر. ويدعم البرنامج المشاريع الزراعية التي يقودها الشباب وفرص العمل؛ وتوفر صفحة المشروع السجل الرسمي والتقارير ذات الصلة. وهذا نشر لتقرير تقدم، وليس دعوة جديدة لتقديم طلبات منح.

pt.title: BAD publica relatório de implementação de junho de 2026 do ENABLE Youth no Quénia
pt.summary: O Banco Africano de Desenvolvimento lista um relatório de progresso de implementação de junho de 2026 para o projeto ENABLE Youth Kenya, que continua em curso. O programa apoia agronegócios liderados por jovens e emprego; a página do projeto disponibiliza o registo oficial e relatórios de implementação relacionados. Trata-se da publicação de um relatório de progresso, não de uma nova candidatura a subsídios.

sw.title: AfDB yachapisha ripoti ya utekelezaji ya Juni 2026 ya ENABLE Youth Kenya
sw.summary: Benki ya Maendeleo ya Afrika imeorodhesha ripoti ya maendeleo ya utekelezaji ya Juni 2026 kwa mradi unaoendelea wa ENABLE Youth Kenya. Mpango huu unaunga mkono biashara za kilimo zinazoongozwa na vijana na ajira; ukurasa wa mradi una rekodi rasmi na ripoti zinazohusiana. Hii ni ripoti ya maendeleo iliyochapishwa, si tangazo jipya la maombi ya ruzuku.

articles.title: Country joins 2026 FAO Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum for agrifood investment
articles.summary: Kenya is among 20 African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment plans at the FAO 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome from 13–16 October 2026.

articles.title: FAO Hand-in-Hand Kenya 2026 — agrifood investment opportunities
articles.summary: Kenya's 2026 Hand-in-Hand investment plan is among the government-led African investment cases presented to agrifood investors.

articles.title: FAO Hand-in-Hand Kenya 2026 — coffee value-chain investment portfolio
articles.summary: FAO's Kenya 2026 investment profile identifies a USD 50 million portfolio with a 22.49% internal rate of return, USD 31.78 million NPV and 1.53 million direct beneficiaries. The portfolio focuses on coffee wet and dry mills, honey coffee, the Nairobi Coffee Exchange and cascara tea.

articles.title: Eastern Africa Hand-in-Hand forum advances regional agrifood investment pipeline
articles.summary: FAO's Eastern Africa Hand-in-Hand forum brought governments, investors and partners together around investment-ready opportunities in livestock, coffee, rice, irrigation, fisheries and aquaculture.
articles.source: FAO Subregional Office for Eastern Africa

articles.title: IFAD and Equity Group launch USD 200 million climate-adaptation finance mechanism for East Africa
articles.summary: The 12-year blended finance mechanism will reach 260,000 smallholder producers and 500 rural enterprises across Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania and Rwanda.

articles.title: IFAD and AgDevCo sign USD 10 million agreement for Africa agribusiness financing
articles.summary: The agreement aims to mobilize blended financing for early-stage agribusinesses in Kenya and other initial target countries.

articles.title: World Bank Group soil-health programme expands agricultural-support reform
articles.summary: Kenya is one of six African countries participating in a programme focused on better fertilizer-support design, soil testing, digital farm registries, research and extension.

articles.title: IFAD’s East and Southern Africa irrigation partnership grant call closed on 15 May 2026
articles.summary: IFAD’s 4P4SID call sought eligible organizations with experience in irrigation development and multi-country partnerships to support smallholder irrigation schemes in Ethiopia, Malawi, Rwanda and Zimbabwe. The submission deadline was 15 May 2026 and has passed. This was a call for an implementing partner, not an open grant for individual Kenyan farmers.

fr.title: L’appel d’IFAD pour les partenariats d’irrigation en Afrique de l’Est et australe a pris fin le 15 mai 2026
fr.summary: L’appel 4P4SID d’IFAD visait des organisations admissibles ayant de l’expérience en développement de l’irrigation et en partenariats multinationaux, pour soutenir les petits périmètres irrigués en Éthiopie, au Malawi, au Rwanda et au Zimbabwe. La date limite était le 15 mai 2026 et elle est dépassée. Il s’agissait d’un appel à sélectionner un partenaire d’exécution, et non d’une subvention ouverte aux agriculteurs kényans.

ar.title: انتهى في 15 مايو 2026 طلب إيفاد لشراكات الري في شرق أفريقيا وجنوبها
ar.summary: استهدف طلب 4P4SID من إيفاد المنظمات المؤهلة ذات الخبرة في تطوير الري والشراكات متعددة البلدان لدعم نظم ري صغار المزارعين في إثيوبيا وملاوي ورواندا وزيمبابوي. انتهى الموعد النهائي للتقديم في 15 مايو 2026. كانت هذه دعوة لاختيار شريك منفذ، وليست منحة مفتوحة للمزارعين الأفراد في كينيا.

pt.title: O concurso do FIDA para parcerias de irrigação na África Oriental e Austral encerrou em 15 de maio de 2026
pt.summary: O concurso 4P4SID do FIDA procurava organizações elegíveis com experiência em desenvolvimento de irrigação e parcerias multinacionais para apoiar sistemas de irrigação de pequenos agricultores na Etiópia, Malawi, Ruanda e Zimbabué. O prazo terminou em 15 de maio de 2026. Tratava-se da seleção de um parceiro de implementação, não de uma subvenção aberta a agricultores quenianos individuais.

sw.title: Wito wa IFAD wa ushirikiano wa umwagiliaji Afrika Mashariki na Kusini ulifungwa tarehe 15 Mei 2026
sw.summary: Wito wa 4P4SID wa IFAD ulitafuta taasisi zinazostahili zenye uzoefu wa maendeleo ya umwagiliaji na ushirikiano wa nchi nyingi ili kusaidia mifumo ya umwagiliaji wa wakulima wadogo Ethiopia, Malawi, Rwanda na Zimbabwe. Tarehe ya mwisho ilikuwa 15 Mei 2026 na imepita. Huu ulikuwa wito wa kuchagua mshirika wa utekelezaji, si ruzuku ya wazi kwa wakulima binafsi wa Kenya.

articles.title: Kenya included in AICCRA–FSRP4 climate-smart innovation scale-up
articles.summary: Kenya is one of six countries participating in the World Bank-backed initiative to expand climate-smart agricultural solutions and climate information services to farmers and food-system actors.

articles.title: Kenya Climate-Smart Agriculture Project receives four-year funding extension in Busia
articles.summary: Kenya's Government Advertising Agency reports that Busia County secured an additional four-year funding extension for the Kenya Climate-Smart Agriculture Project (KELCOP), intended to expand project interventions and reach more farmers while strengthening value chains and gender-inclusive agribusiness.
articles.source: Government Advertising Agency / Kenya News Agency

fr.title: Le projet kényan d’agriculture intelligente face au climat obtient quatre années de financement supplémentaires à Busia
fr.summary: Selon l’Agence gouvernementale de publicité du Kenya, le comté de Busia a obtenu une prolongation de financement de quatre ans pour le projet d’agriculture intelligente face au climat (KELCOP), afin d’étendre ses interventions, d’atteindre davantage d’agriculteurs et de renforcer les chaînes de valeur ainsi que l’agroentrepreneuriat inclusif.

ar.title: مشروع الزراعة الذكية مناخياً في كينيا يحصل على تمديد تمويل لأربع سنوات في بوسيا
ar.summary: أفادت وكالة الإعلان الحكومية الكينية بأن مقاطعة بوسيا حصلت على تمديد تمويل إضافي لمدة أربع سنوات لمشروع الزراعة الذكية مناخياً (KELCOP)، بهدف توسيع التدخلات والوصول إلى مزيد من المزارعين وتعزيز سلاسل القيمة والأعمال الزراعية الشاملة للنوع الاجتماعي.

pt.title: Projeto queniano de agricultura climaticamente inteligente recebe extensão de financiamento de quatro anos em Busia
pt.summary: A Agência Governamental de Publicidade do Quénia informa que o condado de Busia conseguiu uma extensão adicional de quatro anos de financiamento para o Projeto de Agricultura Climaticamente Inteligente do Quénia (KELCOP), para ampliar as intervenções, alcançar mais agricultores e reforçar as cadeias de valor e o agronegócio inclusivo.

sw.title: Mradi wa Kenya wa kilimo kinachozingatia mabadiliko ya tabianchi wapata nyongeza ya ufadhili wa miaka minne Busia
sw.summary: Shirika la Matangazo la Serikali ya Kenya linaripoti kuwa Kaunti ya Busia imepata nyongeza ya miaka minne ya ufadhili kwa Mradi wa Kilimo Kinachozingatia Mabadiliko ya Tabianchi wa Kenya (KELCOP), ili kupanua shughuli zake, kuwafikia wakulima zaidi na kuimarisha minyororo ya thamani pamoja na biashara jumuishi za kilimo.

articles.title: Kenya announces Sh270 million irrigation and dam projects in Nandi
articles.summary: Kenya News Agency reports that four irrigation and dam projects worth Sh270 million are planned across Nandi Hills, Tinderet and Mosop. The projects aim to improve water availability, agricultural productivity and resilience to unreliable rainfall; implementation and long-term benefits depend on delivery, maintenance and farmer support.

fr.title: Le Kenya annonce des projets d’irrigation et de barrages de 270 millions de shillings à Nandi
fr.summary: L’agence Kenya News Agency rapporte que quatre projets d’irrigation et de barrages, d’un montant total de 270 millions de shillings, sont prévus dans les zones de Nandi Hills, Tinderet et Mosop. Ils visent à améliorer l’accès à l’eau, la productivité agricole et la résilience face aux pluies irrégulières ; les résultats dépendront de la réalisation des travaux, de l’entretien et de l’accompagnement des agriculteurs.

ar.title: كينيا تعلن مشاريع ري وسدود بقيمة 270 مليون شلن في ناندي
ar.summary: أفادت وكالة الأنباء الكينية بأن أربعة مشاريع للري والسدود بقيمة إجمالية تبلغ 270 مليون شلن مخططة في مناطق ناندي هيلز وتينديريت وموسوب. وتهدف المشاريع إلى تحسين توفر المياه والإنتاجية الزراعية والقدرة على مواجهة عدم انتظام الأمطار؛ وستعتمد النتائج على التنفيذ والصيانة ودعم المزارعين.

pt.title: Quénia anuncia projetos de irrigação e barragens de 270 milhões de xelins em Nandi
pt.summary: A Kenya News Agency informa que estão previstos quatro projetos de irrigação e barragens, no valor total de 270 milhões de xelins, nas áreas de Nandi Hills, Tinderet e Mosop. Os projetos pretendem melhorar o acesso à água, a produtividade agrícola e a resiliência à irregularidade das chuvas; os resultados dependerão da execução, manutenção e apoio aos agricultores.

sw.title: Kenya yatangaza miradi ya umwagiliaji na mabwawa ya shilingi milioni 270 Nandi
sw.summary: Shirika la Habari la Kenya linaripoti kuwa miradi minne ya umwagiliaji na mabwawa yenye thamani ya shilingi milioni 270 imepangwa katika maeneo ya Nandi Hills, Tinderet na Mosop. Miradi hiyo inalenga kuboresha upatikanaji wa maji, uzalishaji wa kilimo na uwezo wa kukabiliana na mvua zisizotabirika; matokeo yatategemea utekelezaji, matengenezo na msaada kwa wakulima.

articles.title: Kenya tractor-financing scheme offers eligible North Rift buyers up to 95% financing
articles.summary: Kenya News Agency reports that NCBA Bank and Car & General announced a tractor and implement financing arrangement launched in Eldoret. Eligible borrowers may finance up to 95% of the equipment cost, with repayment periods up to 60 months and a 60-day repayment holiday. These are reported programme terms, not a guarantee of approval; farmers should confirm eligibility, pricing, fees, security requirements and current availability with the providers.

fr.title: Un programme de financement de tracteurs au Kenya propose jusqu’à 95 % de financement aux acheteurs admissibles du North Rift
fr.summary: La Kenya News Agency rapporte que NCBA Bank et Car & General ont annoncé à Eldoret un dispositif de financement de tracteurs et d’équipements. Les emprunteurs admissibles pourraient financer jusqu’à 95 % du coût des équipements, avec des remboursements pouvant aller jusqu’à 60 mois et un délai de grâce de 60 jours. Ces conditions sont celles rapportées pour le programme et ne garantissent pas l’approbation ; les agriculteurs doivent vérifier l’admissibilité, les prix, les frais, les garanties et la disponibilité auprès des prestataires.

ar.title: برنامج تمويل الجرارات في كينيا يتيح تمويلاً يصل إلى 95% للمشترين المؤهلين في منطقة نورث ريفت
ar.summary: ذكرت وكالة الأنباء الكينية أن بنك NCBA وشركة Car & General أعلنا في إلدوريت عن ترتيب لتمويل الجرارات والمعدات. ويمكن للمقترضين المؤهلين تمويل ما يصل إلى 95% من تكلفة المعدات، مع فترات سداد تصل إلى 60 شهراً وفترة سماح لمدة 60 يوماً. هذه هي الشروط التي أوردها التقرير وليست ضماناً للموافقة؛ وينبغي للمزارعين تأكيد الأهلية والأسعار والرسوم والضمانات والتوافر الحالي لدى الجهات المقدمة.

pt.title: Programa de financiamento de tratores no Quénia oferece até 95% de financiamento a compradores elegíveis no North Rift
pt.summary: A Kenya News Agency informa que o NCBA Bank e a Car & General anunciaram em Eldoret um acordo de financiamento de tratores e equipamentos. Os mutuários elegíveis poderão financiar até 95% do custo dos equipamentos, com prazos de reembolso até 60 meses e um período de carência de 60 dias. Estas são as condições comunicadas para o programa, não uma garantia de aprovação; os agricultores devem confirmar elegibilidade, preços, taxas, garantias e disponibilidade atual junto dos fornecedores.

sw.title: Mpango wa ufadhili wa matrekta Kenya watoa hadi 95% ya ufadhili kwa wanunuzi wanaostahili North Rift
sw.summary: Shirika la Habari la Kenya linaripoti kuwa NCBA Bank na Car & General zilitangaza Eldoret mpango wa kufadhili matrekta na vifaa. Wakopaji wanaostahili wanaweza kufadhili hadi 95% ya gharama ya vifaa, kwa muda wa ulipaji hadi miezi 60 na kipindi cha mapumziko cha siku 60. Haya ndiyo masharti yaliyoripotiwa, si dhamana ya kuidhinishwa; wakulima wanapaswa kuthibitisha ustahiki, bei, ada, dhamana na upatikanaji wa sasa kwa watoa huduma.

fr.title: L’appel d’IFAD pour la certification biologique de la macadamia au Rwanda a pris fin le 5 janvier 2026
fr.summary: L’appel ELPS d’IFAD visait à sélectionner un partenaire chargé d’aider les petits producteurs de macadamia ciblés au Rwanda à obtenir une certification biologique et à améliorer l’accès aux marchés. La page officielle indique une date limite au 5 janvier 2026, désormais dépassée. Il s’agissait de sélectionner un partenaire d’exécution, et non d’un appel à subventions actuellement ouvert aux agriculteurs individuels.

ar.title: انتهى في 5 يناير 2026 طلب إيفاد لدعم شهادة العضوية العضوية للمكاديميا في رواندا

pt.title: O concurso do FIDA para certificação biológica da macadâmia no Ruanda encerrou em 5 de janeiro de 2026

fr.title: Le Liberia et la KOICA signent une subvention de 1 million de dollars pour les jeunes ruraux dans les filières du riz et du manioc
