Le programme se poursuit jusqu’en 2030 et commence par un projet pilote dans le comté de Bong. Il vise à renforcer les compétences et les possibilités d’emploi des jeunes dans la production, la transformation, la commercialisation et le transport du riz et du manioc, ainsi que dans l’agroalimentaire. Le projet est mis en œuvre avec la FAO ; l’annonce ne constitue pas un appel public à candidatures.

ar.title: ليبيريا ووكالة كويكا توقعان منحة بمليون دولار للشباب الريفي في سلاسل قيمة الأرز والكسافا
ar.summary: وقعت وزارة الزراعة في ليبيريا والوكالة الكورية للتعاون الدولي منحة بقيمة مليون دولار لمشروع الوظائف الخضراء للشباب في النظم الزراعية والغذائية القادرة على الصمود. يستمر البرنامج حتى عام 2030 ويبدأ بمرحلة تجريبية في مقاطعة بونغ. ويهدف إلى تنمية مهارات الشباب وفرص عملهم في إنتاج الأرز والكسافا وتصنيعهما وتسويقهما ونقلهما والأعمال الزراعية المرتبطة بهما. ويُنفذ المشروع بالتعاون مع منظمة الأغذية والزراعة؛ ولا يعلن الخبر عن فتح باب تقديم طلبات عامة.

pt.title: Libéria e KOICA assinam subvenção de US$ 1 milhão para jovens rurais nas cadeias do arroz e da mandioca
pt.summary: O Ministério da Agricultura da Libéria e a Agência de Cooperação Internacional da Coreia assinaram uma subvenção de US$ 1 milhão para o projeto Empregos Verdes para Jovens em Sistemas Agroalimentares Resilientes. O programa decorre até 2030 e começa com um projeto-piloto no condado de Bong. Pretende desenvolver competências e oportunidades de emprego para jovens na produção, transformação, comercialização e transporte de arroz e mandioca, bem como em atividades agroindustriais relacionadas. O projeto é implementado com a FAO; o anúncio não indica uma candidatura pública aberta.

sw.title: Liberia na KOICA zasaini ruzuku ya dola milioni 1 kwa vijana wa vijijini katika minyororo ya thamani ya mpunga na muhogo
sw.summary: Wizara ya Kilimo ya Liberia na Shirika la Ushirikiano wa Kimataifa la Korea zimesaini ruzuku ya dola milioni 1 kwa mradi wa Ajira za Kijani kwa Vijana katika Mifumo Imara ya Kilimo na Chakula. Mpango utaendelea hadi 2030 na kuanza kwa majaribio katika Kaunti ya Bong. Unalenga kujenga ujuzi na fursa za ajira kwa vijana katika uzalishaji, uchakataji, uuzaji na usafirishaji wa mpunga na muhogo pamoja na biashara zinazohusiana na kilimo. Mradi unatekelezwa kwa ushirikiano na FAO; tangazo hili halisemi kuwa kuna maombi ya umma yaliyofunguliwa.

articles.title: Liberia's CARI–SADFONS project reaches 100 tonnes of seed rice and receives farm machinery
articles.summary: Liberia's Central Agricultural Research Institute reports that the SADFONS project has produced more than 100 metric tonnes of seed rice toward a 250-tonne target. The African Development Bank donated a 90-horsepower tractor and other machinery to support mechanisation, seed production and food security. The project works across 11 counties and supports rice, cassava and vegetables.

fr.title: Le projet CARI–SADFONS au Liberia atteint 100 tonnes de semences de riz et reçoit du matériel agricole
fr.summary: L’Institut central de recherche agricole du Liberia indique que le projet SADFONS a produit plus de 100 tonnes de semences de riz, sur un objectif de 250 tonnes. La Banque africaine de développement a fait don d’un tracteur de 90 chevaux et d’autres équipements pour soutenir la mécanisation, la production de semences et la sécurité alimentaire. Le projet intervient dans 11 comtés et soutient le riz, le manioc et les légumes.

ar.title: مشروع CARI–SADFONS في ليبيريا ينتج 100 طن من بذور الأرز ويتلقى معدات زراعية
ar.summary: أعلن المعهد المركزي للبحوث الزراعية في ليبيريا أن مشروع SADFONS أنتج أكثر من 100 طن متري من بذور الأرز من هدف يبلغ 250 طناً. وقد تبرع بنك التنمية الأفريقي بجرار بقوة 90 حصاناً ومعدات أخرى لدعم الميكنة وإنتاج البذور والأمن الغذائي. ويعمل المشروع في 11 مقاطعة ويدعم زراعة الأرز والكسافا والخضروات.

pt.title: Projeto CARI–SADFONS na Libéria atinge 100 toneladas de sementes de arroz e recebe máquinas agrícolas
pt.summary: O Instituto Central de Investigação Agrícola da Libéria informa que o projeto SADFONS produziu mais de 100 toneladas métricas de sementes de arroz, rumo à meta de 250 toneladas. O Banco Africano de Desenvolvimento doou um trator de 90 cavalos e outras máquinas para apoiar a mecanização, a produção de sementes e a segurança alimentar. O projeto atua em 11 condados e apoia arroz, mandioca e hortícolas.

sw.title: Mradi wa CARI–SADFONS nchini Liberia wafikia tani 100 za mbegu za mpunga na kupokea mashine za kilimo
sw.summary: Taasisi Kuu ya Utafiti wa Kilimo ya Liberia inasema mradi wa SADFONS umezalisha zaidi ya tani 100 za mbegu za mpunga kuelekea lengo la tani 250. Benki ya Maendeleo ya Afrika imetoa trekta ya nguvu za farasi 90 na vifaa vingine kusaidia umechanishaji, uzalishaji wa mbegu na usalama wa chakula. Mradi unafanya kazi katika kaunti 11 na kusaidia mpunga, muhogo na mboga.

articles.title: Liberia agriculture minister seeks US$69 million budget to strengthen farmer support
articles.summary: Liberia's Ministry of Agriculture requested US$69 million in the 2027 national budget to strengthen agricultural extension and farmer support. The request is not yet an approved allocation. The ministry says Liberia has 138 agricultural technicians for 109 districts, and highlights priorities including rice, cassava, cocoa, coffee, rubber and oil palm value chains.
articles.source: Ministry of Agriculture, Republic of Liberia

fr.title: Le ministère de l’Agriculture du Liberia demande 69 millions de dollars pour soutenir les agriculteurs
fr.summary: Le ministère de l’Agriculture du Liberia a demandé 69 millions de dollars dans le budget national 2027 afin de renforcer les services de vulgarisation agricole et le soutien aux agriculteurs. Il s’agit d’une demande, et non d’un crédit déjà approuvé. Le ministère indique que le pays compte 138 techniciens agricoles pour 109 districts et met en avant les filières du riz, du manioc, du cacao, du café, du caoutchouc et du palmier à huile.

ar.title: وزارة الزراعة في ليبيريا تطلب 69 مليون دولار لتعزيز دعم المزارعين
ar.summary: طلبت وزارة الزراعة في ليبيريا تخصيص 69 مليون دولار في الميزانية الوطنية لعام 2027 لتعزيز الإرشاد الزراعي ودعم المزارعين. وهذا طلب تمويل وليس اعتماداً تمت الموافقة عليه بالفعل. وتقول الوزارة إن لدى البلاد 138 فنياً زراعياً لخدمة 109 مناطق زراعية، مع التركيز على سلاسل قيمة الأرز والكسافا والكاكاو والقهوة والمطاط ونخيل الزيت.

pt.title: Ministério da Agricultura da Libéria pede US$ 69 milhões para reforçar o apoio aos agricultores
pt.summary: O Ministério da Agricultura da Libéria solicitou US$ 69 milhões no orçamento nacional de 2027 para reforçar os serviços de extensão agrícola e o apoio aos agricultores. O valor é um pedido, não uma dotação já aprovada. O ministério informa que o país tem 138 técnicos agrícolas para 109 distritos e destaca as cadeias de valor do arroz, mandioca, cacau, café, borracha e óleo de palma.

sw.title: Wizara ya Kilimo ya Liberia yaomba dola milioni 69 kuimarisha msaada kwa wakulima
sw.summary: Wizara ya Kilimo ya Liberia imeomba dola milioni 69 katika bajeti ya taifa ya mwaka 2027 ili kuimarisha huduma za ugani wa kilimo na msaada kwa wakulima. Hii ni ombi la fedha, si mgao ambao tayari umeidhinishwa. Wizara inasema nchi ina maafisa wa ugani wa kilimo 138 kwa wilaya za kilimo 109, na inaangazia minyororo ya thamani ya mpunga, muhogo, kakao, kahawa, mpira na mawese.

articles.title: FAO Hand-in-Hand Liberia 2026 highlights rice, cocoa and maize investment
articles.summary: FAO's Liberia 2026 profile presents USD 370 million of investment opportunities in rice, cassava, cocoa and maize, with a strong focus on import substitution and value-chain development.

articles.title: Country joins 2026 FAO Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum for agrifood investment
articles.summary: Liberia is among 20 African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment plans at the FAO 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome from 13–16 October 2026.

articles.title: Atoms4Food assessment charts a path toward food security in Liberia
articles.summary: FAO and IAEA's Atoms4Food country assessment is examining how science and nuclear techniques can support food security, agricultural productivity, food safety and nutrition in Liberia.

articles.title: Madagascar highlights rice, maize, soybean and special economic zones in 2026 agrifood investment agenda
articles.summary: Madagascar's 2026 Hand-in-Hand agenda includes rice, maize and soybean value chains and six special economic zones targeting market gardening, rice, maize, soybean and fodder.

articles.title: AfDB publishes procurement notice for Madagascar’s Lower Mangoky irrigation expansion Phase II
articles.summary: The African Development Bank published a general procurement notice on 27 July 2026 for the Lower Mangoky Irrigation Area Expansion Project, Phase II. The notice describes aims including improving rice self-sufficiency, agricultural productivity and rural incomes in southwest Madagascar. This is a project procurement notice, not a public farmer grant.

fr.title: La BAD publie un avis général de marché pour la phase II de l’extension de l’irrigation du Bas-Mangoky à Madagascar
fr.summary: La Banque africaine de développement a publié le 27 juillet 2026 un avis général de marché pour la phase II du projet d’extension du périmètre irrigué de Bas-Mangoky. L’avis mentionne notamment l’amélioration de l’autosuffisance en riz, de la productivité agricole et des revenus ruraux dans le sud-ouest de Madagascar. Il s’agit d’un avis de marché, et non d’une subvention destinée directement aux agriculteurs.

ar.title: البنك الأفريقي للتنمية ينشر إعلان مشتريات للمرحلة الثانية من توسيع ري منطقة مانغوكي السفلى في مدغشقر
ar.summary: نشر البنك الأفريقي للتنمية في 27 يوليو 2026 إعلان مشتريات عام للمرحلة الثانية من مشروع توسيع منطقة ري مانغوكي السفلى. ويذكر الإعلان أهدافاً تشمل تحسين الاكتفاء الذاتي من الأرز والإنتاجية الزراعية والدخل الريفي في جنوب غرب مدغشقر. وهذا إعلان مشروع ومشتريات، وليس منحة عامة للمزارعين.

pt.title: BAD publica aviso geral de contratação para a Fase II da expansão da irrigação de Lower Mangoky, em Madagáscar
pt.summary: O Banco Africano de Desenvolvimento publicou em 27 de julho de 2026 um aviso geral de contratação para a Fase II do projeto de expansão da área irrigada de Lower Mangoky. O aviso descreve objetivos como melhorar a autossuficiência em arroz, a produtividade agrícola e os rendimentos rurais no sudoeste de Madagáscar. Trata-se de um aviso de contratação do projeto, não de um subsídio público para agricultores.

sw.title: AfDB yachapisha tangazo la ununuzi la Awamu ya II ya upanuzi wa umwagiliaji Lower Mangoky, Madagaska
sw.summary: Benki ya Maendeleo ya Afrika ilichapisha tangazo la jumla la ununuzi tarehe 27 Julai 2026 kwa Awamu ya II ya mradi wa kupanua eneo la umwagiliaji la Lower Mangoky. Tangazo linataja malengo ya kuboresha kujitosheleza kwa mchele, uzalishaji wa kilimo na mapato ya vijijini kusini-magharibi mwa Madagaska. Hili ni tangazo la ununuzi wa mradi, si ruzuku ya umma kwa wakulima.

articles.title: Country joins 2026 FAO Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum for agrifood investment
articles.summary: Madagascar is among 20 African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment plans at the FAO 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome from 13–16 October 2026.

articles.title: AfDB records emergency agricultural support for Cyclone Gezani-affected populations in Madagascar
articles.summary: An AfDB emergency grant approved in May 2026 supports populations affected by Cyclone Gezani during the country's recovery period.

articles.title: AfDB project page lists Malawi fisheries, aquaculture and watershed progress report
articles.summary: The African Development Bank’s official project page lists a December 2025 implementation progress report for Malawi’s Sustainable Fisheries, Aquaculture and Watershed Management Project, published on 6 August 2026. The project focuses on resilience in fishing and aquaculture communities and watershed management. The project page is the direct source for the report and related project documents.

fr.title: La page de la BAD répertorie le rapport d’avancement du projet de pêche, d’aquaculture et de gestion des bassins versants au Malawi
fr.summary: La page officielle du projet de la Banque africaine de développement répertorie un rapport d’avancement de décembre 2025 pour le projet de pêche durable, d’aquaculture et de gestion des bassins versants au Malawi, publié le 6 août 2026. Le projet vise à renforcer la résilience des communautés de pêche et d’aquaculture ainsi que la gestion des bassins versants. La page du projet est la source directe du rapport et des documents associés.

ar.title: صفحة مشروع البنك الأفريقي للتنمية تعرض تقرير تقدم مشروع مصايد الأسماك والاستزراع المائي وإدارة مستجمعات المياه في ملاوي
ar.summary: تعرض صفحة المشروع الرسمية للبنك الأفريقي للتنمية تقرير تقدم التنفيذ لشهر ديسمبر 2025 لمشروع مصايد الأسماك المستدامة والاستزراع المائي وإدارة مستجمعات المياه في ملاوي، وقد نُشر في 6 أغسطس 2026. ويركز المشروع على تعزيز قدرة مجتمعات الصيد والاستزراع المائي على الصمود وإدارة مستجمعات المياه. وتعد صفحة المشروع المصدر المباشر للتقرير والوثائق ذات الصلة.

pt.title: Página do BAD lista relatório de progresso do projeto de pesca, aquicultura e gestão de bacias hidrográficas no Malawi
pt.summary: A página oficial do projeto do Banco Africano de Desenvolvimento lista um relatório de progresso de dezembro de 2025 do Projeto de Pesca Sustentável, Aquicultura e Gestão de Bacias Hidrográficas do Malawi, publicado em 6 de agosto de 2026. O projeto centra-se na resiliência das comunidades piscatórias e aquícolas e na gestão de bacias hidrográficas. A página do projeto é a fonte direta do relatório e dos documentos relacionados.

sw.title: Ukurasa wa AfDB unaorodhesha ripoti ya maendeleo ya mradi wa uvuvi, ufugaji wa samaki na usimamizi wa vyanzo vya maji Malawi
sw.summary: Ukurasa rasmi wa mradi wa Benki ya Maendeleo ya Afrika unaorodhesha ripoti ya maendeleo ya Desemba 2025 ya Mradi wa Uvuvi Endelevu, Ufugaji wa Samaki na Usimamizi wa Vyanzo vya Maji Malawi, iliyochapishwa tarehe 6 Agosti 2026. Mradi unalenga kuimarisha ustahimilivu wa jamii za uvuvi na ufugaji wa samaki pamoja na usimamizi wa vyanzo vya maji. Ukurasa wa mradi ndio chanzo cha moja kwa moja cha ripoti na nyaraka zinazohusiana.

articles.title: Zambezi Basin countries advance $130 million climate-resilience programme
articles.summary: Malawi is participating in the AfDB-supported Zambezi Basin programme, which is advancing climate-smart agriculture, water management, resilient livelihoods and food security across the eight basin countries.

articles.title: Country joins 2026 FAO Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum for agrifood investment
articles.summary: Malawi is among 20 African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment plans at the FAO 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome from 13–16 October 2026.

articles.title: World Bank Group soil-health programme expands agricultural-support reform
articles.summary: Malawi is one of six African countries participating in a programme focused on better fertilizer-support design and soil health.

articles.title: IFAD TRADE programme continues agricultural diversification and entrepreneurship support in Malawi
articles.summary: IFAD's project portfolio lists a July 2026 supervision report for the Transforming Agriculture through Diversification and Entrepreneurship Programme, covering agricultural diversification, entrepreneurship and rural value chains in Malawi.

articles.title: AfDB and Mali business leaders strengthen access to private-sector financing
articles.summary: Stakeholders discussed financing instruments, bankable projects, blended finance, guarantees and technical assistance, including opportunities in agro-industry and the cotton value chain.

articles.title: Climate-smart agriculture initiative targets Mali smallholders through research and innovation
articles.summary: Mali is included in the AICCRA–FSRP4 regional initiative, which aims to scale climate-smart solutions and climate information services and strengthen connections between research and farmers.

articles.title: IITA study highlights climate-smart agriculture potential for Mali smallholders
articles.summary: A September 2026 IITA and IER study found that climate-smart agriculture practices could strengthen food security and improve diet quality among smallholder farming households facing climate and insecurity pressures.

articles.title: AfDB project page lists Morocco’s rural and agricultural development support programme update
articles.summary: The African Development Bank’s official project page for Morocco’s PADIDZAR programme lists a May 2026 implementation progress report published on 26 June 2026. The programme supports inclusive and sustainable development in agricultural and rural areas. The direct project page contains related reports and should be used instead of the generic agriculture-news listing.

fr.title: La page de la BAD répertorie une mise à jour du programme marocain de développement agricole et rural
fr.summary: La page officielle du programme PADIDZAR de la Banque africaine de développement répertorie un rapport d’avancement de mai 2026, publié le 26 juin 2026. Le programme soutient le développement inclusif et durable des zones agricoles et rurales. La page directe du projet contient les rapports associés et remplace la liste générique des actualités agricoles.

ar.title: صفحة مشروع البنك الأفريقي للتنمية تعرض تحديثاً لبرنامج دعم التنمية الزراعية والريفية في المغرب
ar.summary: تعرض صفحة البرنامج الرسمي PADIDZAR للبنك الأفريقي للتنمية تقرير تقدم لشهر مايو 2026 نُشر في 26 يونيو 2026. ويدعم البرنامج التنمية الشاملة والمستدامة في المناطق الزراعية والريفية. وتحتوي صفحة المشروع المباشرة على التقارير ذات الصلة بدلاً من قائمة أخبار الزراعة العامة.

pt.title: Página do BAD lista atualização do programa de apoio ao desenvolvimento agrícola e rural de Marrocos
pt.summary: A página oficial do programa PADIDZAR do Banco Africano de Desenvolvimento lista um relatório de progresso de maio de 2026, publicado em 26 de junho de 2026. O programa apoia o desenvolvimento inclusivo e sustentável das zonas agrícolas e rurais. A página direta do projeto contém os relatórios relacionados e substitui a listagem genérica de notícias agrícolas.

sw.title: Ukurasa wa AfDB unaorodhesha sasisho la mpango wa maendeleo ya kilimo na maeneo ya vijijini Morocco
sw.summary: Ukurasa rasmi wa mpango wa PADIDZAR wa Benki ya Maendeleo ya Afrika unaorodhesha ripoti ya maendeleo ya Mei 2026 iliyochapishwa tarehe 26 Juni 2026. Mpango huu unaunga mkono maendeleo jumuishi na endelevu katika maeneo ya kilimo na vijijini. Ukurasa wa moja kwa moja wa mradi una ripoti zinazohusiana na kuchukua nafasi ya orodha ya jumla ya habari za kilimo.

articles.title: IFAD approves new rural development project in Morocco's Khenifra province
articles.summary: IFAD's project list records approval of an Integrated Rural Development Project in Khenifra on 15 September 2026.

articles.title: AfDB lists Morocco PAASIFEJ environmental and social technical assistance
articles.summary: The African Development Bank's agriculture portfolio records new technical assistance for implementation of Morocco's PAASIFEJ environmental and social action plan, approved in June 2026.

articles.title: FAO Hand-in-Hand Mozambique 2026 highlights seed, irrigation and mechanization opportunities
articles.summary: FAO's Mozambique 2026 profile presents USD 135.05 million of investment opportunities in certified seed multiplication, private irrigation management, processing and mechanization.

articles.title: Zambezi Basin countries advance $130 million climate-resilience programme
articles.summary: Mozambique is participating in the AfDB-supported Zambezi Basin programme, which is advancing climate-smart agriculture, water management, resilient livelihoods and food security across the eight basin countries.

articles.title: Cuamba Agri-Hub infrastructure procurement advances under Mozambique SAPZ
articles.summary: The African Development Bank published an October 2026 procurement notice for the Cuamba Agri-Hub signature gate, road accessibility and supporting office in Niassa Province under the Pemba-Lichinga Integrated Development Corridor Special Agri-Industrial Processing Zone.

articles.title: IFAD-backed PROCAVA expands climate-resilient agrifood value-chain focus in Mozambique
articles.summary: IFAD's current project page describes PROCAVA across 75 districts and all 10 provinces, targeting irrigated horticulture, red meat, poultry, cassava and legumes to improve resilient rural incomes.

articles.title: Country joins 2026 FAO Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum for agrifood investment
articles.summary: Mozambique is among 20 African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment plans at the FAO 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome from 13–16 October 2026.

articles.title: AfDB advances Cuamba Agri-Hub infrastructure under Mozambique SAPZ
articles.summary: An AfDB-financed Special Agri-Industrial Processing Zone in Niassa Province is advancing construction and supporting infrastructure for the Cuamba Agri-Hub.

articles.title: Zambezi Basin countries advance $130 million climate-resilience programme
articles.summary: Namibia is participating in the AfDB-supported Zambezi Basin programme, which is advancing climate-smart agriculture, water management, resilient livelihoods and food security across the eight basin countries.

articles.title: FAO strengthens early action around Southern Africa climate outlook
articles.summary: FAO highlighted the 2026 Southern Africa climate outlook and the need for early agricultural preparedness as drier conditions were forecast for the coming season.

articles.title: IITA strengthens seed systems in São Tomé and Príncipe
articles.summary: IITA is supporting seed-system development for cassava, maize, sweet potato and yam to strengthen food security and rural livelihoods.

articles.title: African countries strengthen capacities on agricultural heritage systems
articles.summary: FAO reported that a Johannesburg workshop brought 16 African countries together to strengthen agricultural heritage system proposals, action plans and partnerships.

fr.title: Les pays africains renforcent leurs capacités sur les systèmes de patrimoine agricole
fr.summary: La FAO a indiqué qu'un atelier organisé à Johannesburg a réuni 16 pays africains pour renforcer les propositions, plans d'action et partenariats relatifs aux systèmes de patrimoine agricole.

ar.title: الدول الأفريقية تعزز قدراتها بشأن نظم التراث الزراعي
ar.summary: أفادت الفاو بأن ورشة عمل في جوهانسبرغ جمعت 16 دولة أفريقية لتعزيز المقترحات وخطط العمل والشراكات الخاصة بنظم التراث الزراعي.

pt.title: Países africanos reforçam capacidades sobre sistemas de património agrícola
pt.summary: A FAO informou que um workshop realizado em Joanesburgo reuniu 16 países africanos para reforçar propostas, planos de ação e parcerias sobre sistemas de património agrícola.

sw.title: Nchi za Afrika zinaimarisha uwezo kuhusu mifumo ya urithi wa kilimo
sw.summary: FAO iliripoti kuwa warsha iliyofanyika Johannesburg ilileta pamoja nchi 16 za Afrika ili kuimarisha mapendekezo, mipango ya utekelezaji na ushirikiano kuhusu mifumo ya urithi wa kilimo.

articles.title: World Bank adds $140 million for Senegal's agricultural production areas
articles.summary: Additional financing is expanding resilient rural connectivity, processing platforms, storage, market access and community infrastructure in major agricultural corridors.

articles.title: FAO highlights stronger implementation of Africa's agrifood commitments
articles.summary: FAO's regional conference work in Africa is emphasizing implementation, investment, innovation and measurable results for agrifood transformation.

articles.title: Senegal launches AgriConnect Compact to transform agriculture
articles.summary: The compact prioritizes grains, horticulture and livestock, combining agricultural infrastructure and services, policy reform and private investment.

articles.title: World Bank Group soil-health programme expands agricultural-support reform
articles.summary: Senegal is one of six African countries participating in a programme focused on better fertilizer-support design, soil health and agricultural productivity.

articles.title: African countries strengthen tools for better agrifood public spending
articles.summary: FAO reported new work helping African countries use evidence and tools to improve agrifood public spending and investment planning.

articles.title: FAO strengthens West Africa climate and environment support mechanism
articles.summary: FAO's West Africa regional office strengthened its Climate and Environment mechanism to help countries translate climate and environmental priorities into resilient agrifood-system action.
articles.source: FAO Subregional Office for West Africa

articles.title: FAO Senegal highlights women farmers and rural entrepreneurs
articles.summary: Women farmers, livestock keepers, processors, oyster harvesters, beekeepers and rural entrepreneurs were highlighted during Senegal activities recognising their role in food security and local development.
articles.source: FAO Subregional Office for West Africa

articles.title: Senegal joins regional scale-up of climate-smart agricultural innovation
articles.summary: The AICCRA–FSRP4 initiative includes Senegal among six African countries where climate-smart agricultural solutions and climate information services are being expanded.

articles.title: Senegal expands digital tracking of subsidized agricultural inputs
articles.summary: Senegal’s Ministry of Agriculture, Food Sovereignty and Livestock announced the nationwide rollout of its Agro-Pastoral Platform (ERP PAS) to modernize distribution of subsidized fertilizer and seeds. The ministry reports that the pilot enrolled more than 60,000 producers and tracked about CFAF 6.4 billion in subsidies through 213,847 transactions; these are ministry-reported pilot figures, not an independent impact evaluation.
articles.source: Senegal Ministry of Agriculture, Food Sovereignty and Livestock (MASAE)

fr.title: Le Sénégal étend le suivi numérique de la distribution des intrants agricoles subventionnés
fr.summary: Le ministère sénégalais de l’Agriculture, de la Souveraineté alimentaire et de l’Élevage a annoncé le déploiement national de la plateforme agro-pastorale (ERP PAS) pour moderniser la distribution des engrais et semences subventionnés. Le ministère indique que la phase pilote a enrôlé plus de 60 000 producteurs et suivi environ 6,4 milliards de FCFA de subventions au moyen de 213 847 opérations ; ces chiffres proviennent du ministère et ne constituent pas une évaluation indépendante de l’impact.

ar.title: السنغال توسّع التتبع الرقمي لتوزيع المدخلات الزراعية المدعومة
ar.summary: أعلنت وزارة الزراعة والسيادة الغذائية والثروة الحيوانية في السنغال التوسع الوطني لمنصة الزراعة والرعي (ERP PAS) لتحديث توزيع الأسمدة والبذور المدعومة. وتقول الوزارة إن المرحلة التجريبية سجلت أكثر من 60 ألف منتج وتتبعَت نحو 6.4 مليار فرنك أفريقي من الدعم عبر 213,847 معاملة؛ وهذه أرقام أبلغت عنها الوزارة وليست تقييماً مستقلاً للأثر.

pt.title: Senegal amplia o acompanhamento digital da distribuição de insumos agrícolas subsidiados
pt.summary: O Ministério da Agricultura, Soberania Alimentar e Pecuária do Senegal anunciou a expansão nacional da Plataforma Agro-Pastoral (ERP PAS) para modernizar a distribuição de fertilizantes e sementes subsidiados. O ministério informa que a fase-piloto registou mais de 60 mil produtores e acompanhou cerca de 6,4 mil milhões de FCFA em subsídios através de 213 847 operações; são números divulgados pelo ministério, não uma avaliação independente do impacto.

sw.title: Senegal yaongeza ufuatiliaji wa kidijitali wa usambazaji wa pembejeo za kilimo zinazofadhiliwa
sw.summary: Wizara ya Kilimo, Ukuu wa Chakula na Ufugaji ya Senegal imetangaza upanuzi wa kitaifa wa Jukwaa la Kilimo na Ufugaji (ERP PAS) ili kuboresha usambazaji wa mbolea na mbegu zinazofadhiliwa. Wizara inasema awamu ya majaribio ilisajili wazalishaji zaidi ya 60,000 na kufuatilia takriban faranga bilioni 6.4 za CFA za ruzuku kupitia miamala 213,847; hizi ni takwimu zilizotolewa na wizara, si tathmini huru ya athari.

articles.title: FAO Hand-in-Hand Sierra Leone 2026 highlights rice and value-chain investment
articles.summary: FAO's Sierra Leone 2026 profile presents USD 760 million of investment opportunities, with rice, mechanization, processing, aggregation and finance among the priorities.

articles.title: AfDB publishes appraisal report for Sierra Leone’s rice agro-industrial zone Phase I
articles.summary: The African Development Bank’s project appraisal report for Sierra Leone’s Rice Special Agro-Industrial Processing Zone Phase I was published on 23 April 2026. The project aligns with the Feed Salone strategy and focuses on climate-resilient rice production, mechanization, improved certified seeds, private-sector participation and value-chain finance. This is an appraisal document, not an announcement that all planned works are complete.

fr.title: La BAD publie le rapport d’évaluation de la phase I de la zone agro-industrielle du riz en Sierra Leone
fr.summary: Le rapport d’évaluation de la Banque africaine de développement pour la phase I de la zone spéciale agro-industrielle de transformation du riz en Sierra Leone a été publié le 23 avril 2026. Le projet s’inscrit dans la stratégie Feed Salone et met l’accent sur la production de riz résiliente au climat, la mécanisation, les semences certifiées améliorées, la participation du secteur privé et le financement des chaînes de valeur. Il s’agit d’un document d’évaluation, et non d’une confirmation que tous les travaux prévus sont achevés.

ar.title: البنك الأفريقي للتنمية ينشر تقرير تقييم المرحلة الأولى من المنطقة الزراعية الصناعية للأرز في سيراليون
ar.summary: نشر البنك الأفريقي للتنمية تقرير تقييم مشروع المنطقة الخاصة للتصنيع الزراعي للأرز في سيراليون، المرحلة الأولى، في 23 أبريل 2026. ويتوافق المشروع مع استراتيجية Feed Salone ويركز على إنتاج الأرز القادر على التكيف مع المناخ، والميكنة، والبذور المحسنة المعتمدة، ومشاركة القطاع الخاص وتمويل سلاسل القيمة. هذا مستند تقييم، وليس إعلاناً عن اكتمال جميع الأعمال المخططة.

pt.title: BAD publica relatório de avaliação da Fase I da zona agroindustrial do arroz na Serra Leoa
pt.summary: O relatório de avaliação do Banco Africano de Desenvolvimento para a Fase I da Zona Especial de Processamento Agroindustrial do Arroz na Serra Leoa foi publicado em 23 de abril de 2026. O projeto está alinhado com a estratégia Feed Salone e centra-se na produção de arroz resiliente ao clima, mecanização, sementes certificadas melhoradas, participação do setor privado e financiamento das cadeias de valor. Trata-se de um documento de avaliação, não de um anúncio de que todas as obras previstas foram concluídas.

sw.title: AfDB yachapisha ripoti ya tathmini ya Awamu ya I ya eneo la viwanda vya kilimo vya mchele Sierra Leone
sw.summary: Ripoti ya tathmini ya Benki ya Maendeleo ya Afrika ya Awamu ya I ya Eneo Maalum la Usindikaji wa Kilimo na Viwanda vya Mchele Sierra Leone ilichapishwa tarehe 23 Aprili 2026. Mradi unaendana na mkakati wa Feed Salone na unalenga uzalishaji wa mchele unaostahimili mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa, uboreshaji wa mitambo, mbegu bora zilizoidhinishwa, ushiriki wa sekta binafsi na ufadhili wa minyororo ya thamani. Hii ni hati ya tathmini, si tangazo kwamba kazi zote zilizopangwa zimekamilika.

articles.title: Country joins 2026 FAO Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum for agrifood investment
articles.summary: Sierra Leone is among 20 African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment plans at the FAO 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome from 13–16 October 2026.

articles.title: Flood risks and funding shortfalls threaten vulnerable communities
articles.summary: FAO reported projected floods and funding shortfalls as continuing threats to food security and livelihoods in Somalia.

fr.title: Les risques d'inondation et les déficits de financement menacent les communautés vulnérables
fr.summary: La FAO a signalé que les inondations prévues et les déficits de financement continuent de menacer la sécurité alimentaire et les moyens de subsistance en Somalie.

ar.title: مخاطر الفيضانات ونقص التمويل يهددان المجتمعات الهشة
ar.summary: أفادت الفاو بأن الفيضانات المتوقعة ونقص التمويل لا يزالان يشكلان تهديداً للأمن الغذائي وسبل العيش في الصومال.

pt.title: Riscos de cheias e défices de financiamento ameaçam comunidades vulneráveis
pt.summary: A FAO informou que as cheias previstas e os défices de financiamento continuam a ameaçar a segurança alimentar e os meios de subsistência na Somália.

sw.title: Hatari za mafuriko na upungufu wa fedha zinatishia jamii zilizo hatarini
sw.summary: FAO iliripoti kuwa mafuriko yanayotarajiwa na upungufu wa fedha vinaendelea kutishia usalama wa chakula na maisha ya watu nchini Somalia.

articles.title: AfDB publishes completion report for Horn of Africa climate-resilient rural livelihoods project in Somalia
articles.summary: The African Development Bank published the project completion report for the IGAD-led Rural Livelihoods’ Adaptation to Climate Change in the Horn of Africa II (RLACC II) project on 27 September 2026. The report describes work on pastoral and agro-pastoral resilience, water management, livestock services and livelihood diversification, while noting that fragility limited full achievement of objectives.

fr.title: La BAD publie le rapport d’achèvement du projet de résilience climatique des moyens de subsistance ruraux en Somalie
fr.summary: La Banque africaine de développement a publié le 27 septembre 2026 le rapport d’achèvement du projet RLACC II, dirigé par l’IGAD, sur l’adaptation des moyens de subsistance ruraux au changement climatique dans la Corne de l’Afrique. Le rapport décrit les travaux sur la résilience pastorale et agro-pastorale, la gestion de l’eau, les services d’élevage et la diversification des moyens de subsistance, tout en indiquant que la fragilité a limité l’atteinte complète des objectifs.

ar.title: البنك الأفريقي للتنمية ينشر تقرير إكمال مشروع سبل العيش الريفية المقاومة للمناخ في الصومال
ar.summary: نشر البنك الأفريقي للتنمية في 27 سبتمبر 2026 تقرير إكمال مشروع RLACC II الذي تقوده الهيئة الحكومية للتنمية (إيغاد) بشأن تكيف سبل العيش الريفية مع تغير المناخ في القرن الأفريقي. ويصف التقرير العمل على تعزيز صمود المجتمعات الرعوية والزراعية الرعوية وإدارة المياه وخدمات الثروة الحيوانية وتنويع سبل العيش، مع الإشارة إلى أن الهشاشة حدّت من تحقيق الأهداف بالكامل.

pt.title: BAD publica relatório de conclusão do projeto de meios de subsistência rurais resilientes ao clima na Somália
pt.summary: O Banco Africano de Desenvolvimento publicou em 27 de setembro de 2026 o relatório de conclusão do projeto RLACC II, liderado pela IGAD, sobre adaptação dos meios de subsistência rurais às alterações climáticas no Corno de África. O relatório descreve ações de resiliência pastoral e agropastoril, gestão da água, serviços pecuários e diversificação dos meios de subsistência, observando que a fragilidade limitou o cumprimento integral dos objetivos.

sw.title: AfDB yachapisha ripoti ya kukamilika kwa mradi wa maisha ya vijijini unaostahimili mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa Somalia
sw.summary: Benki ya Maendeleo ya Afrika ilichapisha tarehe 27 Septemba 2026 ripoti ya kukamilika kwa mradi wa RLACC II unaoongozwa na IGAD kuhusu kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa katika Pembe ya Afrika. Ripoti inaeleza kazi za kuimarisha ustahimilivu wa jamii za wafugaji na wakulima-wafugaji, usimamizi wa maji, huduma za mifugo na utofauti wa njia za kujipatia kipato, huku ikibainisha kuwa hali ya udhaifu ilizuia kufikiwa kikamilifu kwa malengo.

articles.title: Eastern Africa Hand-in-Hand forum advances regional agrifood investment pipeline
articles.summary: FAO's Eastern Africa Hand-in-Hand forum brought governments, investors and partners together around investment-ready opportunities in livestock, coffee, rice, irrigation, fisheries and aquaculture.
articles.source: FAO Subregional Office for Eastern Africa

articles.title: AfDB advances gender and social inclusion under Somalia's BREFONS project
articles.summary: Current project support focuses on mainstreaming gender and social inclusion and strengthening participation of women, youth and vulnerable groups in resilience activities.

articles.title: FAO strengthens early-warning capacity for Somalia's climate and food-security risks
articles.summary: FAO highlighted strengthened early-warning and anticipatory-action capacity to help Somalia respond earlier to climate and food-security risks.

articles.title: IFAD and South Sudan launch US$41.8 million Sustainable Agriculture Development Project
articles.summary: The SADEP project aims to strengthen food security and rural resilience, including climate-resilient sorghum and fisheries value chains, market access and agricultural services.

articles.title: South Sudan launches US$41.8 million sustainable agriculture and rural resilience project
articles.summary: IFAD and the Government of South Sudan launched SADEP to support more than 110,000 people through climate-resilient sorghum and fisheries value chains, market access, finance, extension and rural infrastructure.

articles.title: Eastern Africa Hand-in-Hand forum advances regional agrifood investment pipeline
articles.summary: FAO's Eastern Africa Hand-in-Hand forum brought governments, investors and partners together around investment-ready opportunities in livestock, coffee, rice, irrigation, fisheries and aquaculture.
articles.source: FAO Subregional Office for Eastern Africa

articles.title: FAO launches nationwide livestock vaccination campaign
articles.summary: FAO reported a nationwide livestock vaccination campaign in Sudan aimed at protecting food security and rural livelihoods amid conflict.

fr.title: La FAO lance une campagne nationale de vaccination du bétail
fr.summary: La FAO a annoncé une campagne nationale de vaccination du bétail au Soudan visant à protéger la sécurité alimentaire et les moyens de subsistance ruraux dans le contexte du conflit.

ar.title: الفاو تطلق حملة وطنية لتطعيم الثروة الحيوانية
ar.summary: أعلنت الفاو عن حملة وطنية لتطعيم الثروة الحيوانية في السودان تهدف إلى حماية الأمن الغذائي وسبل العيش الريفية وسط الصراع.

pt.title: FAO lança campanha nacional de vacinação do gado
pt.summary: A FAO informou sobre uma campanha nacional de vacinação do gado no Sudão destinada a proteger a segurança alimentar e os meios de subsistência rurais em meio ao conflito.

sw.title: FAO yazindua kampeni ya kitaifa ya chanjo kwa mifugo
sw.summary: FAO imeripoti kampeni ya kitaifa ya chanjo kwa mifugo nchini Sudan inayolenga kulinda usalama wa chakula na maisha ya vijijini wakati wa mzozo.

articles.title: AfDB and WFP launch $87 million BOOST agriculture resilience project in Sudan
articles.summary: BOOST is designed to help farming communities restore production, reduce post-harvest losses, improve incomes and strengthen links to local markets.

articles.title: AfDB and partners launch BOOST to strengthen Sudan's agricultural recovery
articles.summary: BOOST targets 232,000 smallholder farmers in Blue Nile and Sennar, combining climate-resilient seeds, technology, storage, processing and finance for youth and women.

articles.title: IITA partners advance Sudan Digital Agriculture and Food Safety Academy
articles.summary: The pilot is building digital learning resources on food safety, climate-smart agriculture, agronomy, plant health and postharvest management for Sudanese farmers and agribusinesses.

articles.title: Zimbabwe presents investment opportunities at FAO Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum
articles.summary: FAO reported Zimbabwe's participation in the 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum to present agrifood investment opportunities.

fr.title: Le Zimbabwe présente des opportunités d'investissement au Forum d'investissement Hand-in-Hand de la FAO
fr.summary: La FAO a indiqué que le Zimbabwe a participé au Forum d'investissement Hand-in-Hand 2026 pour présenter des opportunités d'investissement dans les systèmes agroalimentaires.

ar.title: زيمبابوي تعرض فرصاً استثمارية في منتدى الفاو للاستثمار ضمن مبادرة هاند-إن-هاند
ar.summary: أفادت الفاو بأن زيمبابوي شاركت في منتدى الاستثمار هاند-إن-هاند لعام 2026 لعرض فرص الاستثمار في النظم الزراعية والغذائية.

pt.title: Zimbabué apresenta oportunidades de investimento no Fórum de Investimento Hand-in-Hand da FAO
pt.summary: A FAO informou que o Zimbabué participou no Fórum de Investimento Hand-in-Hand 2026 para apresentar oportunidades de investimento nos sistemas agroalimentares.

sw.title: Zimbabwe yaonyesha fursa za uwekezaji katika Jukwaa la Uwekezaji la FAO la Hand-in-Hand
sw.summary: FAO iliripoti kuwa Zimbabwe ilishiriki katika Jukwaa la Uwekezaji la Hand-in-Hand 2026 ili kuwasilisha fursa za uwekezaji katika mifumo ya kilimo na chakula.

articles.title: AfDB approves $25 million climate-resilience grant for Zimbabwe
articles.summary: The ACRES project targets climate-exposed rural communities and aims to strengthen smallholder agriculture, grazing areas, water resources and private-sector investment.

articles.title: AfDB approves US$25 million grant for Zimbabwe’s drought resilience and food security
articles.summary: The African Development Bank announced on 23 April 2026 that it had approved a US$25 million grant for the Zimbabwe Agricultural Climate Resilient and Vulnerability Reduction Project (ACRES), planned for 2026–2030. The project targets drought-exposed rural districts and aims to support smallholder farmers, grazing areas, water resources and climate resilience. The grant is a project financing decision, not a direct open application for individual farmers.

fr.title: La BAD approuve une subvention de 25 millions de dollars pour la résilience à la sécheresse et la sécurité alimentaire au Zimbabwe
fr.summary: La Banque africaine de développement a annoncé le 23 avril 2026 l’approbation d’une subvention de 25 millions de dollars pour le projet ACRES au Zimbabwe, prévu pour 2026–2030. Le projet cible des districts ruraux exposés à la sécheresse et vise à soutenir les petits agriculteurs, les pâturages, les ressources en eau et la résilience climatique. Il s’agit d’une décision de financement de projet, et non d’un appel ouvert aux demandes individuelles des agriculteurs.

ar.title: البنك الأفريقي للتنمية يوافق على منحة بقيمة 25 مليون دولار لتعزيز القدرة على مواجهة الجفاف والأمن الغذائي في زيمبابوي
ar.summary: أعلن البنك الأفريقي للتنمية في 23 أبريل 2026 الموافقة على منحة بقيمة 25 مليون دولار لمشروع ACRES في زيمبابوي، والمخطط تنفيذه بين عامي 2026 و2030. ويستهدف المشروع مناطق ريفية معرضة للجفاف ويهدف إلى دعم صغار المزارعين والمراعي والموارد المائية والقدرة على التكيف مع المناخ. وهذا قرار تمويل لمشروع، وليس دعوة مفتوحة للتقديم الفردي من المزارعين.

pt.title: BAD aprova subvenção de 25 milhões de dólares para resiliência à seca e segurança alimentar no Zimbabué
pt.summary: O Banco Africano de Desenvolvimento anunciou em 23 de abril de 2026 a aprovação de uma subvenção de 25 milhões de dólares para o projeto ACRES no Zimbabué, previsto para 2026–2030. O projeto abrange distritos rurais expostos à seca e pretende apoiar pequenos agricultores, pastagens, recursos hídricos e resiliência climática. Trata-se de uma decisão de financiamento de projeto, não de um convite aberto a candidaturas individuais de agricultores.

sw.title: AfDB yaidhinisha ruzuku ya dola milioni 25 kwa ustahimilivu wa ukame na usalama wa chakula Zimbabwe
sw.summary: Benki ya Maendeleo ya Afrika ilitangaza tarehe 23 Aprili 2026 kuidhinisha ruzuku ya dola milioni 25 kwa mradi wa ACRES nchini Zimbabwe, uliopangwa kwa kipindi cha 2026–2030. Mradi unalenga wilaya za vijijini zilizoathiriwa na ukame na kusaidia wakulima wadogo, malisho, rasilimali za maji na ustahimilivu wa hali ya hewa. Huu ni uamuzi wa ufadhili wa mradi, si mwaliko wa wazi wa maombi binafsi ya wakulima.

articles.title: Zambezi Basin countries advance $130 million climate-resilience programme
articles.summary: Zimbabwe is participating in the AfDB-supported Zambezi Basin programme, which is advancing climate-smart agriculture, water management, resilient livelihoods and food security across the eight basin countries.

articles.title: Country joins 2026 FAO Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum for agrifood investment
articles.summary: Zimbabwe is among 20 African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment plans at the FAO 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome from 13–16 October 2026.

articles.title: FAO Hand-in-Hand Zimbabwe 2026 — agrifood investment opportunities
articles.summary: Zimbabwe's 2026 Hand-in-Hand investment plan includes mechanization, irrigation and agrifood value-chain investment opportunities.

articles.title: Zimbabwe takes USD 1.65 billion agrifood portfolio to FAO Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum
articles.summary: Zimbabwe's 2026 Hand-in-Hand portfolio includes maize, soyabean, blueberries, dairy and the Dam as an Economic driver, with combined investment needs of USD 1.65 billion.

articles.title: FAO calls for stronger implementation of CAADP commitments
articles.summary: FAO urged African countries to move from commitments to implementation, investment and measurable results as the continent pursues agrifood-system transformation.

articles.title: Zimbabwe advances five-year seed roadmap and investment plan
articles.summary: A May 2026 Seed Business Summit and Roadmap Workshop brought government, CGIAR and sector partners together around a five-year roadmap covering variety development, seed production, certification, marketing and farmer access.
